metaDescription: Install the Inventatory public beta on Windows x64 or Ubuntu Linux x86-64 with verified release packages.
heading: Download Inventatory
lead: Choose Windows or Ubuntu Linux to see the matching installer. Inventatory keeps your inventory on your own computer, and a scanner is optional.

notes.heading: Already installed?
notes.text: Use Settings → Updates in Inventatory. The updater shows release notes, downloads the package, verifies its published hashes, and hands off to the installer.

notes.heading: Scanner resources
notes.text: A public Scan R1 firmware release and assembly package have not been verified. Use the scanner documentation to understand the existing desktop integration and its setup requirements.

notes.heading: Source code and license
notes.text: The desktop application is published under GPL-3.0-only. Build instructions and developer documentation live with the source.
